_comment: Neutral (English) translations for VisuAuth.AdminUi. Keys are grouped by page; pt-BR translations live in SharedResources.pt-BR.json next to this file. Adding a key here without a matching pt-BR entry falls back to this value. Resolution: IStringLocalizer<SharedResources>.
Users.Title: Users
Users.Detail.TempPasswordDesc: Hand it to the user — VisuAuth will not show it again. They will be signed out of every device until they use it.
Users.Profile.Heading: Profile
Users.Security.Heading: Security
Users.Security.LockConfirm: Lock this user's account? They will not be able to sign in until you unlock them.
Users.Security.ResetPasswordConfirm: Reset the password? A new temporary password will be generated and shown once.
Users.Security.Reset2faConfirm: Reset two-factor? The user will need to set up their authenticator again.
Users.Security.RevokeSessionsConfirm: Sign this user out of every device?
Users.Roles.Heading: Roles
Users.Roles.NoneInBackend: No roles exist in the backend yet. Roles can be created via the roles catalogue (coming in a follow-up PR) or seeded directly with RoleManager.
Users.Roles.AllAssigned: This user already has every available role.
Users.Claims.Heading: Claims
Users.External.Heading: External logins
Users.Danger.Heading: Danger zone
Users.Danger.Desc: Deleting a user removes them and all their claims, roles, and external login links. This cannot be undone.
Users.Danger.DeleteConfirm: Permanently delete this user? This cannot be undone.
Users.New.Heading: New user
Users.New.Subtitle: Provision a fresh account in this backend.
Users.New.TempPasswordDesc: Hand it to the user — VisuAuth will not show it again.
Users.New.UsernamePlaceholder: Defaults to the email when blank
Users.New.PasswordPlaceholder: Leave blank to autogenerate a temporary one
Users.New.EmailConfirmedLabel: Email already verified (skip the confirmation flow)
Users.New.RolesHint: Select the roles the new user should land in. You can change these later from the user detail page.
Roles.Title: Roles
Roles.Empty: No roles defined yet. Use the form above to create the first one.
Roles.DeleteConfirm: Delete role '{0}'? Users currently in this role will lose it.
Tenants.Title: Tenants
Tenants.Empty: No tenants defined yet. Use the form above to create the first one.
Tenants.DeleteConfirm: Delete tenant '{0}'? It must have no members first.
Users.Action.TempPasswordGenerated: Temporary password generated. Hand it to the user — it will not be shown again.
Users.Action.TwoFactorReset: Two-factor disabled and authenticator key reset.
Users.Error.RegistrationNotSupported: This backend does not support user creation.
AuditLog.Title: Audit log
AuditLog.Subtitle: Every sensitive admin and end-user action recorded by VisuAuth, ordered most-recent first. Filter by actor, action code, target id, outcome, or date range.
AuditLog.NotEnabled.Heading: Audit log plugin is not enabled.
AuditLog.NotEnabled.Body: Call AddVisuAuthAuditLog() in Program.cs to start recording. Existing handler call sites are already wired — turning the plugin on is the only step left.
AuditLog.Empty: No audit entries match the current filter.
AuditLog.Filter.FocusTargetTitle: Show only events for this target
ExternalProviders.Title: External providers
ExternalProviders.Subtitle: Edit OAuth credentials at runtime — overrides appsettings / user-secrets without an app restart. Active providers are the schemes your host wired with AddVisuAuthDynamicExternalProviderOptions<TOptions>; the Available section lists popular providers you could add to Program.cs.
ExternalProviders.Empty: No external providers wired yet. Pick one from the Available section below and follow the install snippet to add it to Program.cs.
ExternalProviders.Section.ActiveHint: Wired in Program.cs — edit ClientId / ClientSecret here.
ExternalProviders.Section.AvailableHint: Popular OAuth providers VisuAuth recognises. Add them to Program.cs to activate.
ExternalProviders.Section.OrphanHint: These rows have stored credentials for schemes that are no longer wired in Program.cs. They never appear on /visuauth/login — delete them to keep things tidy.
ExternalProviders.Ghost.NotWiredTooltip: Your host hasn't called AddVisuAuthDynamicExternalProviderOptions for this scheme yet.
ExternalProviders.Orphan.DeleteConfirm: Delete the stored credentials for '{0}'? This cannot be undone.
ExternalProviders.Error.SchemeNotRegiste: Scheme '{0}' is not wired with AddVisuAuthDynamicExternalProviderOptions — saving here would have no effect.
ExternalProviders.Error.DeleteFailed: Failed to delete the provider row.
ExternalProviders.BulkHint: Enables or disables every provider in this list. Use to temporarily lock all external sign-in during incidents without re-typing each secret.
ExternalProviders.Docs.OfficialDocsToolt: Open the provider's official documentation for creating OAuth credentials (new tab).
ExternalProviders.Source.FromDbTooltip: Edited via this admin page and stored in the database.
ExternalProviders.Source.FromCodeTooltip: Supplied by appsettings / user-secrets / Program.cs lambda before the admin overlay runs.
ExternalProviders.Source.DbOverridesCode: Database value overrides the one from code at runtime.
ExternalProviders.Source.CodeOverriddenB: Present in code but the database value wins at runtime.
ExternalProviders.Secret.PlaceholderRepl: Leave blank to keep the stored secret
ExternalProviders.Error.SaveFailed: Failed to save the provider configuration.
